description: This file defines the PerformanceReview entity class, which models performance review data within the OrangeHRM system, including properties related to review periods, statuses, comments, ratings, and relationships to other entities such as Employee, JobTitle, Subunit, and Reviewer.

classes.name: PerformanceReview
classes.description: Entity class representing a performance review, including review periods, status, comments, ratings, and relationships to other HR entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: getStatusId
methods.description: Returns the status ID of the review.

methods.name: setStatusId
methods.description: Sets the status ID of the review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the start date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Sets the start date of the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the end date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Sets the end date of the review period.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date for the review.

methods.name: setDueDate
methods.description: Sets the due date for the review.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: getActivatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was activated.

methods.name: setActivatedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was activated.

methods.name: getFinalComment
methods.description: Returns the final comment of the review.

methods.name: setFinalComment
methods.description: Sets the final comment of the review.

methods.name: getFinalRate
methods.description: Returns the final rate score.

methods.name: setFinalRate
methods.description: Sets the final rate score.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the associated JobTitle entity.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle with the review.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the associated Subunit entity.

methods.name: setSubunit
methods.description: Associates a Subunit with the review.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity being reviewed.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the review.

methods.name: getReviewers
methods.description: Returns the list of reviewers for this review.

methods.name: setReviewers
methods.description: Sets the list of reviewers for this review.
